validation.clipping: probabilities clipped to [1e-15, 1-1e-15] for log loss

test.clipping: probabilities clipped to [1e-15, 1-1e-15] for log loss

precision_at_k_definition: Expected precision at K with random tie-breaking inside the boundary score group.
protocol_label: Edge-disjoint reverse control on the original split
formula: out_degree(source) * in_degree(target) on the protocol train graph
direction_treatment: Directed: source out-degree and target in-degree

reverse_control.rule: Remove a training edge when its reverse is a validation or test positive.
